t: Luceco FType MK2 fixed fire rated LED downlights provide versatile and efficient lighting solutions for various indoor domestic settings, including kitchens and bathrooms, due to their IP65 rating. The selectable power between 4W and 6W, alongside adjustable colour temperatures from 2700K to 6000K, offers adaptable illumination. Installation is made simple for electricians and tradespersons with Speedfit loop in and out piano terminals, accommodating both solid and stranded cables, complemented by a quickview window for easy connection inspection. A durable steel body ensures longevity, while the 40,000-hour life span provides lasting performance.
